rules.source_quote: All Apple® & Beats products (including mobile phones) must be returned / exchanged within 14 days.

rules.title: Target gives phones only 14 days
rules.window_note: Phones bought in a Target store, or online for Order Pickup, have to come back within 14 days. An opened phone can carry a restocking charge of up to $35 where the law allows it. There's no charge if it's unopened. Phones on a carrier contract must go back in store with a Target Tech rep, and your carrier may charge an early termination fee.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back or a swap, minus up to $35 if the phone was opened.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the phone, its box and accessories to a Target store with your receipt. If you bought it at Target Tech or on a carrier contract, return it at Target Tech.
rules.script_hint: I bought this phone here less than 14 days ago and it's faulty; here's my receipt, and I'd like to return or exchange it.
rules.source_quote: Mobile phones purchased in-store or online via Order Pickup must be returned / exchanged within 14 days.

rules.title: Currys fixes faulty items for 12 months, and refunds them in the first 30 days
rules.window_note: Everything Currys sells comes with a standard 12-month warranty from the day you bought it. In the first 30 days (from when you bought it or had it delivered) you can have an exchange or a refund. After that, Currys may repair it while the 12 months last. Accidental damage, misuse, neglect and normal wear and tear are not covered, and some makers give you longer than 12 months, so check the box too.
rules.what_you_get: An exchange or your money back in the first 30 days. After that, a repair while it is still inside its guarantee.
rules.how_to_claim: On the Returns page of the Currys site, choose 'I want a refund' or 'I want an exchange' and answer the questions about the fault. Have your receipt or order confirmation ready - if you bought online, log in to your Currys account to find it. Or call Currys.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] from Currys less than a year ago and it has developed a fault, so it's still inside your standard 12-month warranty and I'd like it repaired.
rules.source_quote: If more than 30 days have passed since you bought or received your item, we might be able to repair it as long as it’s still within its guarantee period (usually 12 months from when you bought it).

rules.title: Currys takes most things back within 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days. Bought online: you can open it to look it over, but for a full refund it must be unused, like new, in its original box with all its accessories. Bought in a store: it must still be sealed and unopened, and you need your proof of purchase. Some things can't come back once the seal is broken, for hygiene reasons, unless they are faulty. Phones and SIMs on a contract follow the network's own rules.
rules.what_you_get: A full refund, or an exchange if you'd rather.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to the Returns page on the Currys site and follow the steps. Most online orders can also go back to a Currys store. Bring it in its box with every accessory, plus your receipt or order confirmation.
rules.script_hint: I bought this online less than 30 days ago and it's unused and back in its original box with everything, so I'd like a full refund under your 30-day returns policy.
rules.source_quote: If you bought your item online, you can return it within 30 days - even if you’ve opened it for inspection. To get a full refund, the item must be returned like new and in a resaleable condition.

rules.title: Argos repairs or replaces faulty items free for 12 months
rules.window_note: In the first 30 days after you got it, a faulty item gets you a refund, and it does not need its box, tags or to be unused. From then until 12 months, Argos offers a free repair or replacement. If that doesn't fix it, takes too long or causes you real hassle, they offer a refund instead. Things sold by a Trusted Seller on the Argos site go back to that seller, not to an Argos store.
rules.what_you_get: A refund in the first 30 days. After that, up to 12 months, a free repair or replacement, and a refund if that doesn't work.
rules.how_to_claim: If you collected it from a store, take it back to any Argos store. If it was delivered to your home, get in touch through the Argos contact page or live chat. Have your receipt or order confirmation ready.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] from Argos less than 12 months ago and it has developed a fault, so I'd like the free repair or replacement your policy offers.
rules.source_quote: If something goes wrong after the first 30 days but within 12 months, we'll offer to repair or replace the item at no cost to you.

rules.title: Argos gives you 30 days to change your mind
rules.window_note: 30 days from the day you collected it or it was delivered. It must be unused, with all its parts, in its original packaging and fit to sell again, and you need proof of purchase. You can't return personalised items, opened games, DVDs or software, or hygiene items like earphones, razors and toothbrushes once they are used or unsealed. Items from Trusted Sellers follow the seller's own returns.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid. Allow 14 days once they have it back.
rules.how_to_claim: Start the return online with your order number, email and postcode, then take small items to any Argos store. Big items like sofas and fridges have to be collected, so arrange that on live chat. Collection costs £3.95 for small items and £30 for large ones, unless the item is faulty.
rules.script_hint: I got this less than 30 days ago and it's unused in its original packaging, so I'd like to return it under your 30-day returns policy.
rules.source_quote: If you've changed your mind and wish to return an item, you have 30 days from the date of collection or from the date of delivery to request to return your item(s).

rules.title: Argos lets you swap a mattress you can't sleep on within 100 nights
rules.window_note: Within the first 100 days. One swap per purchase, for the same size only, and it must be clean and undamaged, so use a mattress protector. It is for home use only, and mattresses for adjustable beds are not covered. If you paid with an Argos Monthly Payment Plan, PayPal or Klarna, you can only swap for a mattress with the same catalogue number.
rules.what_you_get: A swap for a different mattress in the same size. If the new one is cheaper you get the difference back; if it costs more, you pay the difference.
rules.how_to_claim: Get in touch through the Argos contact page or live chat, or ask in an Argos store, and say you want to exchange your mattress under the 100-night comfort promise.
rules.script_hint: I'm not sleeping well on the mattress I bought from you less than 100 days ago, so I'd like to exchange it under your 100-night comfort promise.
rules.source_quote: If you're not sleeping soundly on your new mattress, you can exchange it within the first 100 days.

rules.title: Amazon UK takes most things back within 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days from when it arrived. It has to be unused and undamaged, in the same state you got it. Hygiene items you've unsealed, opened software, personalised items and things that go off can't go back unless they are faulty. Amazon Haul items only get 15 days. Sending it back is free if it said Free Return when you bought it; otherwise the cost comes off your refund, unless the item is faulty, damaged or wrong.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders and start a return in the Online Returns Centre, then use the drop-off or collection option it gives you. Remove any personal data and sign the device out of your accounts first.
rules.script_hint: This arrived less than 30 days ago and it's unused and undamaged, so I'd like to return it under Amazon's 30-day returns policy.
rules.source_quote: you can return most products from the Amazon sites to Amazon within 30 days of receipt of the products if the products are in an unused and undamaged condition.

rules.title: Amazon UK repairs faulty items it sold you after the 30 days are up
rules.window_note: This starts once the 30-day return window has passed, and only covers items sold by Amazon.co.uk itself or Amazon Resale, not other sellers. The repair is free while the maker's warranty still covers the fault. That is often a year, but check the box or listing, because Amazon's page doesn't set its own limit. Batteries, ink, bulbs and other things that get used up are not covered, and neither is accidental damage or normal wear and tear.
rules.what_you_get: A free repair by the maker or a repairer the maker approves. If it can't be repaired, a replacement; if there's no replacement, your money back.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders. If the item can be repaired, you'll see an option to send it for repair and make a repair label, and Amazon pays you back any postage. Back up and wipe it first. If there's no repair option, contact Amazon customer service.
rules.script_hint: This [item] was sold by Amazon.co.uk and has developed a fault after the 30-day return window, so I'd like it repaired under your policy for defective items.
rules.source_quote: If your item becomes defective after the Amazon return period, Amazon will repair any defective item.

rules.title: Amazon UK refunds you itself when a Marketplace seller won't
rules.window_note: Up to 90 days from the last delivery date on the order, and only for items a Marketplace seller both sold and dispatched. Ask the seller for a return first. If they don't agree within 48 hours or don't fix it, you can claim. You can't claim if you have already done a chargeback with your bank.
rules.what_you_get: Amazon refunds you when the item arrived damaged, faulty or not as described and the seller won't sort it out.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders, find the order, choose Problem with order, pick your problem, then Request Refund. Add a short note and submit. Amazon can take up to a week to decide and tells you by email.
rules.script_hint: The seller didn't agree to take back this faulty item within 48 hours, so I'm asking for a refund under the A-to-z Guarantee.
rules.source_quote: You can request a refund under the A-to-z Guarantee when: A Marketplace Seller sold and dispatched the item you ordered, and; The last delivery date of your order is 90 days or less, and;

rules.title: John Lewis takes things back within 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days, with your receipt or order confirmation. It must be unused, with all its packaging and labels in good condition, and it can't hold your personal data or be registered with the maker. Mattresses, bedding, earrings, opened beauty products, personalised items and opened software can't come back unless they are faulty. Big items that need collecting cost £29.95 to return unless they are faulty or damaged.
rules.what_you_get: An exchange, or a refund to the way you paid within 14 days of sending it back.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it back to a John Lewis shop. If you bought online, you can also use a Waitrose shop, a Click & Collect point or the post - sign in to your John Lewis account to start the return.
rules.script_hint: I bought this less than 30 days ago and it's unused with all its packaging and labels, so I'd like to return it under your 30-day returns policy.
rules.source_quote: If you've changed your mind about keeping your purchase, please return it within 30 days in its original condition with proof of purchase. We'll exchange or refund it

rules.title: John Lewis swaps or refunds anything that turns out faulty in the first 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days from when you bought it, for a fault in how it was made - not damage you caused. Bring proof of purchase, turn off any security features and remove your personal data. After 30 days John Lewis will still repair or replace it under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, and electricals also get John Lewis's own longer guarantee.
rules.what_you_get: An exchange or your money back. After 30 days, a repair or a replacement.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it back with your receipt or order confirmation, or get in touch through the Product problems & guarantees part of the John Lewis contact page.
rules.script_hint: This developed a manufacturing fault within 30 days of buying it here, so under your returns policy I'd like an exchange or a refund.
rules.source_quote: If your product develops a manufacturing fault within 30 days of purchase, please return with proof of purchase and we’ll exchange or refund it.

rules.title: Very takes most things back free within 28 days
rules.window_note: 28 days from when you received it. It must be complete, unused, in its original packaging and with any security tags still on. Some items are left out or have extra conditions, and the product page says so. Sending it back under this guarantee is free.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to your card, or a credit to your Very account if you bought on credit, usually within 5 working days of Very getting it back.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to My Orders in your Very account, choose Return items, pick the item and the reason, then drop it at an InPost locker or shop, or book a home collection. You don't need a printer.
rules.script_hint: I received this less than 28 days ago and it's unused and complete in its original packaging, so I'd like a refund under your 28-day Approval Guarantee.
rules.source_quote: We will refund most goods provided they are returned to us within 28 days of receipt complete, unused, in their original packaging and with any security tags intact.

rules.title: Very has to sort out faulty items, even when it sends you to the maker
rules.window_note: Very covers anything that fails early because of a manufacturing fault. For electricals and furniture, Very may give you a supplier helpline to call. If that helpline lets you down, tell Very and it will take the problem back. Very's page gives no time limit, so the 6 years here comes from UK law (5 years in Scotland).
rules.what_you_get: A repair, a replacement or a refund, depending on the fault.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to My Orders in your Very account, choose to return the item, pick 'Faulty' as the reason and describe the problem in detail. For some items Very will show you a number to call instead. If the fault is a safety worry, call Very.
rules.script_hint: This [item] from Very has failed early because of a manufacturing fault, so I'd like a repair, replacement or refund, and if the supplier helpline can't help I'd like Very to take it back over.
rules.source_quote: If any product we supply fails prematurely due to an inherent fault (manufacturing defect) we will provide you with an appropriate remedy e.g. a repair, replacement, or refund.

rules.title: Home Depot takes most things back within 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days from purchase for most things, with proof of purchase. Home Depot can turn down something you damaged yourself, but a factory fault is fine. Some things get less time: 30 days for TVs, computers, furniture and gas garden tools, 7 days for dehumidifiers, air conditioners and gas generators, and 48 hours for big appliances. With no receipt you may only get store credit at the lowest advertised price and you'll need photo ID, and special orders may cost a 15% restocking fee.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back. Without proof of purchase, you may get store credit at the lowest advertised price instead.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Home Depot store, even if you bought it online, with your receipt or shipping confirmation email, the card you paid with and photo ID. For an online order you can also start a return from Order Details in your Home Depot account and get a UPS label.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 90 days ago and it's faulty, so I'd like to return it under your 90-day policy.
rules.source_quote: Most merchandise can be returned within 90 days with proof of purchase to The Home Depot unless noted below.

rules.title: Home Depot takes back TVs, computers and furniture for only 30 days, and only unopened
rules.window_note: 30 days for furniture, TVs, computers, tractors, framing and roofing compressors, paint sprayers, and gas-powered trimmers, blowers, chain saws, mowers, outdoor augers, tillers, chippers and log splitters. The policy says it has to be unused and still in its factory-sealed box, so a TV that broke after you set it up may be turned down - if so, the maker's warranty is your next stop. Since 7 July 2026, Halloween and holiday decor also get 30 days. The Home Depot card's 365 days does not stretch this.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back for an unused item still in its sealed box.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Home Depot store with your receipt or shipping confirmation email, the card you paid with and photo ID. Gas-powered tools can't be mailed back, so they have to go to a store.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 30 days ago and it's still unused in the sealed box, so I'd like to return it.
rules.source_quote: Return in 30 Days Furniture, Tractors, Framing & Roofing Compressors, Consumer Electronics (televisions and computers), Paint Sprayers and Gas Powered Items in the following categories: Trimmers, Blowers, Chain Saws, Mowers

rules.title: Home Depot gives dehumidifiers, air conditioners and gas generators just 7 days
rules.window_note: 7 days for dehumidifiers, window and portable air conditioners, gas pressure washers and gas generators (not whole-house or stationary ones). Since 7 July 2026 the same 7 days applies to pumps, portable evaporative coolers and portable heaters. It has to be unused and in its factory-sealed box. The Home Depot card's 365 days does not stretch this.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back for an unused item still in its sealed box.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Home Depot store with your receipt, the card you paid with and photo ID. Anything that uses gas or fuel can't be mailed back, so it has to go to a store.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 7 days ago and it's unused in the sealed box, so I'd like to return it.
rules.source_quote: Return in 7 Days Dehumidifiers, Gas Pressure Washers, Air Conditioners (Window and Portable), Gas Generators (other than whole house and stationary generators). All product must be unused and in their original factory-sealed packaging.

rules.title: Home Depot gives you 48 hours to report a damaged or faulty big appliance
rules.window_note: 48 hours from delivery or store pickup, not counting weekends, for fridges, washers, dryers, ranges, dishwashers and over-the-range or built-in microwaves. Every return on these, even unopened ones, has to happen inside those 48 hours. Check it before you accept delivery and refuse it if it's damaged. The Home Depot card's 365 days does not stretch this.
rules.what_you_get: Home Depot takes the damaged or faulty appliance back if you report it in time. Ask whether they will pick it up from your home.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Customer Solutions at 1-800-455-3869 (6 a.m. to 2 a.m., 7 days) or text "Support" to 38698 within 48 hours of delivery or pickup. If you paid by debit with PIN, cash, cheque, store credit or gift card, bring the receipt to a store for the refund.
rules.script_hint: My [item] was delivered yesterday and it's damaged, so I'm reporting it inside your 48-hour window for major appliances.
rules.source_quote: For Major Appliances (including refrigerators, washers, dryers, ranges, dishwashers, and over-the-range or built-in microwaves), contact Customer Solutions at 1-800-455-3869 within 48 hours of delivery (excluding weekends) for any damage or defects.

rules.title: Home Depot gives you 30 days to report an order that arrived broken or missing parts
rules.window_note: 30 days from delivery if your order shows up damaged, incomplete, or needing replacement parts. Big appliances are different: those have to be reported within 48 hours. Home Depot doesn't say exactly what the fix will be, so ask for what you need.
rules.what_you_get: Home Depot sorts the order out - ask for the missing parts, a replacement or a refund.
rules.how_to_claim: Text "Support" to 38698 any time, or call 1-800-430-3376 (6 a.m. to 2 a.m. ET, 7 days) within 30 days of delivery. Have your order number ready.
rules.script_hint: My order arrived damaged less than 30 days ago, and your policy says to contact you within 30 days of delivery to get it put right.
rules.source_quote: If an order arrives damaged or incomplete or needs replacement parts, contact Customer Support ... within 30 days of delivery for resolution.

rules.title: Home Depot replaces Husky hand tools for free if they ever fail
rules.window_note: No time limit on Husky hand tools such as wrenches, sockets, ratchets, pliers, hammers, screwdrivers, knives, and garden tools like rakes and shovels. Other Husky gear has shorter warranties that need a receipt: 5 years on heavy-duty tool chests and tool belts, 3 years on air tools, air hoses, extension cords and work lights, 2 years on wheelbarrows and bins, and 1 year on jacks and jump starters. Misuse, abuse and normal wear are not covered.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement. For the limited-lifetime items, a replacement worth the same or more.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the broken Husky tool to any Home Depot store. For Husky items with a 1- to 5-year warranty, bring the receipt too.
rules.script_hint: This Husky [item] broke, and Husky hand tools have a lifetime warranty, so I'd like a free replacement.
rules.source_quote: If your Husky product ever fails, bring it back and we will replace it for free.

rules.title: Lowe's takes most new, unused things back within 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days from purchase for most new, unused things. Lowe's won't take anything back without proof of purchase, but it can find the sale from your order number, the card you paid with, your phone number or your MyLowe's account. Some things get less time: 48 hours for big appliances and some power gear, and 30 days for TVs, electronics and most outdoor power equipment. Special orders returned after 72 hours cost a 20% restocking fee.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to the way you paid, or an exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Lowe's store in the US with your receipt, or start the return from your order history on Lowes.com. Online orders can be mailed back if they came with a FedEx label. They may ask for photo ID.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 90 days ago and I'd like to return it under your 90-day policy.
rules.source_quote: Most new, unused merchandise can be refunded or exchanged with receipt within 90 days of the original purchase date, unless noted in our Return Policy Exceptions.

rules.title: Paying with a Lowe's card gives you 365 days to return most things
rules.window_note: 365 days instead of 90 if you paid with a MyLowe's Rewards Credit Card, MyLowe's Pro Rewards Credit or American Express card, a Lowe's Commercial Account or Lowe's Business Rewards. Lowe's Pay does not count. Lowe's says the 365 days apply unless an item is listed as an exception, so the short windows for TVs, electronics and outdoor power gear may still apply - ask. Big appliances and other 48-hour items get 30 days with the card.
rules.what_you_get: A full year to return it for a refund or an exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Lowe's store in the US with your receipt and the Lowe's card you paid with, so they can find the purchase.
rules.script_hint: I paid with my Lowe's card, which gives me 365 days to return this instead of 90.
rules.source_quote: MyLowe’s Rewards™ Credit Card (MLRCC) or Lowe’s Business Rewards (LBR): May be returned within 365 days of the date of purchase, unless noted below.

rules.title: Lowe's gives big appliances, generators and some power tools just 48 hours
rules.window_note: 48 hours from delivery or store pickup for fridges, freezers, washers, dryers, ranges, hoods, dishwashers, over-the-range microwaves, cooktops and wall ovens, and also for air conditioners, evaporative coolers, paint sprayers, tile saws, portable generators, pressure washers and chainsaws. If it's still unopened and factory-sealed, or you paid with a Lowe's card, you get 30 days instead - but generators, pressure washers, chainsaws and pole saws don't get the card's extra time. Lowe's Outlet stores only take back appliances that don't work, within 48 hours, at the same outlet.
rules.what_you_get: A refund or exchange, as long as you start the return inside 48 hours. For big items, ask about home pickup.
rules.how_to_claim: Start the return within 48 hours: call Lowe's customer care at 1-800-445-6937 to talk about home pickup, or bring it back to your nearest store with your receipt.
rules.script_hint: My [item] was delivered less than 48 hours ago and I need to start a return under your 48-hour policy.
rules.source_quote: Return must be initiated with Lowe’s within 48 hours of delivery or the time of pickup at a Lowe’s location. Major Appliances: Refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, ranges, range hoods, dishwashers

rules.title: Lowe's gives TVs, electronics and most mowers and yard power tools just 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days from purchase for TVs and electronics, water heaters, heating and cooling systems, and most outdoor power equipment like lawn mowers, leaf blowers, trimmers, snow blowers, tillers and log splitters. CRAFTSMAN battery and electric outdoor tools are the exception - they get the normal 90 days.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to the way you paid, or an exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Lowe's store in the US with your receipt. For something too big to carry, call customer care at 1-800-445-6937 to ask about home pickup.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 30 days ago and I'd like to return it within your 30-day window.
rules.source_quote: You can return these items within 30 days of purchase: Liquid paint, TVs and electronics, Water heaters, Most outdoor power equipment

rules.title: Lowe's will book a free in-home repair if the maker's warranty covers it
rules.window_note: Lowe's sets no deadline of its own for this. The repair is free only if the maker's warranty still covers the fault; if it doesn't, the technician may offer to fix it at your cost. Lowe's doesn't list which products this covers, but it describes a repair visit at your home, so it fits big appliances best.
rules.what_you_get: A factory-certified technician comes to your home, and the repair costs you nothing if the maker's warranty covers it.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Lowe's Service Advantage at 1-888-77-LOWES (1-888-775-6937) to book the visit. Have your Lowe's receipt handy.
rules.script_hint: My [item] from Lowe's has stopped working and it's still under the maker's warranty, so could you set up a factory-certified repair visit?
rules.source_quote: hotline toll-free at 1-888-77-LOWES (56937) to set up a factory-certified service appointment in your home or for general assistance. If the repair is covered by the manufacturer’s warranty, it will be repaired at no cost to you.

rules.title: Lowe's fixes or replaces faulty Kobalt tools for 1 year up to a lifetime
rules.window_note: There's no single deadline: most Kobalt products made after 1 May 2016 carry a guarantee of 1, 3 or 5 years or a lifetime, and the length is on the packaging, the manual, or the tool's page on Lowes.com. Items with the tool/battery badge get 5 years on the tool and 3 years on the battery. It covers faults in materials and workmanship, not misuse, normal wear or parts meant to wear out.
rules.what_you_get: A free repair or replacement. Tools with the Hassle-Free Lifetime Guarantee get a free replacement, no questions asked.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the tool and your proof of purchase back to Lowe's, where you bought it, or call 1-888-3KOBALT.
rules.script_hint: This Kobalt [item] has a fault and it's still inside its guarantee, so I'd like it repaired or replaced at no charge.
rules.source_quote: If you think your product meets the above guarantee criteria, please return it to the place of purchase with valid proof of purchase and the defective product will be repaired or replaced at no charge.

rules.title: Lowe's replaces or refunds trees, shrubs and perennials for a year
rules.window_note: One year from purchase for trees, shrubs and perennials, and you need the receipt. Every other plant gets 30 days.
rules.what_you_get: A replacement plant or your money back.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the plant and your receipt to the customer service desk at any Lowe's.
rules.script_hint: This shrub I bought here died within a year, and your policy covers trees, shrubs and perennials for a year with the receipt.
rules.source_quote: For replacement or refund, a receipt is required for any tree, shrub or perennial purchased at Lowe’s within one year of the original purchase date.

rules.title: GameStop takes new games and gear back for 15 days, and swaps faulty ones
rules.window_note: 15 days from purchase. Unopened new games, consoles, accessories, collectibles and unworn clothing with tags come back for a refund; once opened, they can only be swapped if they're faulty, and only inside the same 15 days. Special and collector's editions get just 7 days. Trading cards, clearance, digital and seasonal items are final sale.
rules.what_you_get: Unopened: your money back to the way you paid. Opened and faulty: a swap for the same item. If they have none left, they may offer store credit.
rules.how_to_claim: Bring it with all its parts and packaging, plus your receipt or GameStop.com order number, to a GameStop store - things bought in a store must go back to a store. They may ask for photo ID. Online orders over $500 can't go back to a store, so call 1-800-883-8895.
rules.script_hint: This [item] stopped working and I bought it here less than 15 days ago, so I'd like to swap it for the same one under your defective exchange policy.
rules.source_quote: New Products (Unopened): Return within 15 days of purchase. ... General Items: Defective products (excluding PCs, PC components, laptops, TVs, and monitors) can be exchanged for an identical replacement within the return window.

rules.title: GameStop swaps a faulty pre-owned game or console within 15 days
rules.window_note: 15 days from purchase to swap a pre-owned item that doesn't work, or 30 days for GameStop Pro members. For a full refund instead, bring it back within 7 days. Pre-owned PCs and tech are left out.
rules.what_you_get: A swap for a working one, or your money back if you're within 7 days.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it with all its parts and your receipt or GameStop.com order number to a GameStop store. Things bought in a store must go back to a store.
rules.script_hint: This pre-owned [item] I bought here less than 15 days ago doesn't work, so I'd like to exchange it under your defective pre-owned policy.
rules.source_quote: Pre-Owned Items: Defective pre-owned products are exchangeable within 15 days (excludes Pre-Owned PCs and Tech).

rules.title: GameStop Pro members get 30 days on unopened games and faulty pre-owned buys
rules.window_note: Pro is GameStop's paid membership. Members can return unopened new games and hardware for 30 days instead of 15, and swap faulty pre-owned items for 30 days instead of 15. Pre-owned PCs and tech are left out.
rules.what_you_get: Unopened new items: your money back. Faulty pre-owned items: a swap for a working one.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to a GameStop store with your receipt or order number and tell them you're a Pro member so they apply the longer window.
rules.script_hint: I'm a GameStop Pro member, so I have 30 days to exchange this faulty pre-owned [item], not 15.
rules.source_quote: Extended Return Period: Unopened new software and hardware are returnable within 30 days. Pre-Owned Items: Exchange defective pre-owned items within 30 days (excludes Pre-Owned PCs and Tech).

rules.title: GameStop gives PCs, laptops, TVs and monitors only 7 days, then sends you to the maker
rules.window_note: 7 days from purchase for PCs, PC parts and accessories, laptops, TVs and monitors, and opened PCs can't be returned at all. If one of these is faulty, GameStop won't swap it - you use the maker's warranty instead. GameStop support can give you the maker's contact details.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back within 7 days if it's unopened. After that, the maker's warranty is your route, and GameStop will tell you who to contact.
rules.how_to_claim: If it's sealed and within 7 days, take it back to the store with your receipt or order number. If it's faulty, call GameStop support at 1-800-883-8895 for the maker's contact details, then start a warranty claim with the maker.
rules.script_hint: This [item] I bought at GameStop is faulty, and your policy says to go to the maker for these, so could you give me the manufacturer's contact details?
rules.source_quote: PCs, PC Components and Accessories, Laptops, TVs, and Monitors: Return within 7 days. ... PCs, PC Components, PC Accessories, Laptops, TVs, and Monitors: Contact the manufacturer directly for assistance.

rules.title: Dick's Sporting Goods takes most things back within 90 days, even damaged ones
rules.window_note: 90 days from purchase in a store, or from the ship date for online orders, and damaged items are accepted inside that time. Dick's may take things back even if opened, tried on or tested, but football helmets, air beds, electric scooters and bikes, mouthguards and Whoop trackers can't come back once opened, and electronics need the original box and parts. Other bikes only come back unused within 24 hours, for size or colour, and pre-owned, demo and refurbished items can only be exchanged within 7 days. DICK'S Warehouse and Going, Going, Gone! stores give 30 days.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back to the way you paid, for most purchases. Without a receipt, store credit at the lowest selling price.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Dick's store with your receipt and the card you paid with. For an online order you can also start a mail return with your order number and billing ZIP code - things bought in a store can't be mailed back. Lost the receipt? Call 1-877-846-9997 and they may be able to send you a copy. If it needs a repair rather than a return, Dick's says to send it to the maker or a service centre the maker approves.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 90 days ago and it's damaged, and your policy accepts damaged returns within 90 days.
rules.source_quote: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Calia, VRST and Golf Galaxy offer a 90-day return policy from the date of purchase for in-store purchases … We will accept damaged item returns either online or in-store within the 90-day return policy.

rules.title: Dick's backs its own brands with a one-year warranty
rules.window_note: One year on gear from Dick's own brands that sold for over $15. Accessories, clothing and shoes from these brands are not covered. Some Ethos, DBX, Nishiki, Quest and DSG products have different terms, Nishiki e-bikes have their own, and only some Adidas, Cobra, Lotto, Marucci, Victus and Prince styles are covered by Dick's.
rules.what_you_get: A fix under Dick's one-year limited warranty. The page doesn't say whether that means a repair, a swap or a refund, so ask.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Dick's customer service at 1-877-846-9997 with your receipt or order number and say the item is from a brand Dick's warrants itself.
rules.script_hint: This [item] is from one of Dick's own brands and broke within a year, so I'd like to claim under Dick's one-year limited warranty.
rules.source_quote: DICK’S generally offers a one-year limited manufacturer’s warranty for products from the brands listed in the chart below if the product has a retail price over $15.

rules.title: Best Buy Canada takes most things back within 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days from the day you bought it in store, or from the day your online order arrived. A faulty item gets the same 30 days, but it has to come back in its original box with everything that came in it. Some things only come back if the box was never opened, including major appliances and headphones, and opened cameras, drones and projectors cost a 15% restocking fee. Phones bought on a carrier plan get only 15 days, and a few things, like earrings, digital downloads and open-box major appliances, can't come back at all.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to the card you paid with, or an exchange. With a gift receipt you get store credit.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Best Buy store in Canada with the receipt, the original box and all the parts and extras, and the card you paid with. They may ask for photo ID. For an online order you can also find it under Order History in your My Best Buy account and choose Start a Return; some items get a prepaid mail label. Turn off Find My or Google's lock on phones, tablets and computers first. Items from Marketplace sellers follow the seller's own policy.
rules.script_hint: I bought this here less than 30 days ago and it isn't working properly; your policy lets me return or exchange a defective item within 30 days.
rules.source_quote: Most products sold by Best Buy can be returned or exchanged within 30 days from the date of your in-store purchase, or 30 days from the date your online order is delivered.

rules.title: Phones bought on a carrier plan at Best Buy Canada get only 15 days
rules.window_note: 15 days from the day you bought it in store, and it has to go back to the same store. If you have told them you have a disability, you get up to 30 days under the CRTC Wireless Code. The carrier's limits on how much you used it can also apply. Phones bought unlocked, without a plan, get the normal 30 days.
rules.what_you_get: A refund or an exchange, as long as the carrier's usage rules allow it.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it back to the same Best Buy store where you bought it, with the receipt, the box, all the accessories and your payment card. Turn off Find My iPhone or Google's Factory Reset Protection before you go.
rules.script_hint: I bought this phone on a carrier plan here less than 15 days ago, so under your policy and the Wireless Code I can still return it.
rules.source_quote: Subject to usage restrictions set by the carriers, cellular and wireless devices purchased with a carrier plan can be returned within 15 days from the date of your in-store purchase.

rules.title: Staples Canada takes most things back within 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days from the day you had it in hand. It has to be in sellable shape, in the original box with the UPC code, manual and parts, plus your receipt or staples.ca invoice. Preferred Business and Teacher's Program members get 60 days. Opened headphones, earbuds, VR headsets and opened software can't come back, and if something turns out faulty after 30 days Staples tells you to contact the maker.
rules.what_you_get: A full refund, or a replacement if you return it in a store.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Staples store with the receipt and the card you paid with. For a staples.ca order, start a self-serve return online and they pick it up from your door, or bring it to any store. If it breaks after 30 days, go to the maker's warranty instead.
rules.script_hint: I bought this here less than 30 days ago and it doesn't work properly; your policy gives me 30 days for a full refund or a replacement.
rules.source_quote: you have 30 days from the date you have the item in hand to initiate a return—14 days for tech items. To qualify for a full refund, or replacement (in-store only)

rules.title: Staples Canada gives laptops, tablets and phones only 14 days
rules.window_note: 14 days from delivery or from the day you bought it in store. This covers computers, laptops, tablets, eReaders and phones, plus drones, gimbals and action cameras if still unopened. Preferred Business and Teacher's Program members get 28 days. Phones bought with a carrier plan follow a separate rule: 15 days from activation, no extensions, back to the store you bought it from.
rules.what_you_get: A full refund, or a replacement if you return it in a store. The store may keep it up to 24 hours to check it, and may offer to fix it if you would rather keep it.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Staples store with the receipt, the original box and all the parts, and the card you paid with. Turn off Activation Lock on Apple devices first. For a staples.ca order you can also start a self-serve return online. If it breaks after 30 days, contact the maker.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] less than 14 days ago and it's faulty; your tech return policy gives me 14 days, so I'd like a refund or a replacement.
rules.source_quote: Tech items have a 14 day return policy from the date they have been delivered or bought in store.

rules.title: Canadian Tire takes back unopened items for 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days from the day you bought it, with your receipt. The item should be unopened and in its original packaging - opened or used items may be refused. A faulty item goes under the maker's warranty instead, and Canadian Tire says you can claim that through the maker or your local store. Bikes, clearance items and a few other things can't be returned at all.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to how you paid, or an exchange. If it is faulty, the maker's warranty applies and it gets repaired or replaced.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Canadian Tire store with the receipt and the Canadian Tire Money you got with it. Photo ID may be asked for. No receipt? They can look up credit or debit purchases from the last 90 days. If it's opened and broken, ask the store to help with the maker's warranty claim, or contact the maker directly. For a damaged online delivery you can't bring in, call before sending anything back.
rules.script_hint: I bought this here less than 90 days ago and have my receipt, so I'd like a refund or an exchange under your returns policy.
rules.source_quote: Unopened items in original packaging returned with a receipt within 90 days of purchase will receive a refund to the original method of payment or will receive an exchange.

rules.title: Canadian Tire gives electronics and gas-powered gear only 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days for home and personal audio and video, cameras, phones and other communications gear, e-scooters, dehumidifiers and portable air conditioners; car electronics like backup cameras, car audio, GPS and remote starters get only 14 days. Gas-powered lawn mowers, snowblowers, generators and outboard motors also get 30 days, but only if new, unused and in the original box - used ones are repaired, if possible, under the maker's warranty at an authorised service centre. Apple AirPods and Beats only come back if unopened. The usual rules still apply: bring your receipt, opened items may be refused, and a faulty item goes under the maker's warranty.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to how you paid, or an exchange. For a faulty item or used gas-powered gear, a repair or replacement under the maker's warranty.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Canadian Tire store with the receipt and the Canadian Tire Money you got with it. If it's used, faulty or past the window, ask the store for help with the maker's warranty or where the authorised service centre is, or contact the maker directly.
rules.script_hint: I bought this here less than 30 days ago and I have my receipt; your policy lets me return electronics within 30 days, so I'd like a refund or an exchange.
rules.source_quote: E-scooters and electronics (home audio & video, personal audio & video, cameras & accessories, communications) may only be returned within 30 days. All other rules apply.

rules.title: Costco Canada refunds almost anything you're not happy with
rules.window_note: Costco Canada doesn't give a time limit for most things, but it says every return is looked at case by case and a manager can say no. Electronics and big appliances are the exception at 90 days. You don't need the box, and a receipt helps but isn't always needed if they can see it came from Costco.
rules.what_you_get: The price you paid, refunded.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to the returns counter at any Costco warehouse with your membership card, and your receipt if you have it. Online orders can go back to a warehouse too - bring the order number. For something big, call your warehouse first.
rules.script_hint: I'm not satisfied with this - Costco guarantees satisfaction on what it sells, so I'd like a refund.
rules.source_quote: We guarantee your satisfaction with every product we sell and will refund your purchase price, with the following exceptions:

rules.title: Costco Canada refunds electronics for 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days from the day you bought it. This covers TVs, major appliances, projectors, computers, cameras, drones, camcorders, music players, tablets, smart watches and phones, plus other electronics Costco names. Phones also depend on your carrier contract. Countertop microwaves are not in this group.
rules.what_you_get: The price you paid, refunded.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to the returns counter at any Costco warehouse with your membership card, and your receipt or order number if you have it. For a TV or appliance too big to carry, call your warehouse first.
rules.script_hint: I bought this here less than 90 days ago and it isn't working right, so I'd like to return it under your 90-day electronics policy.
rules.source_quote: Costco will accept returns within 90 days from the date of purchase for televisions, major appliances*, projectors, computers, cameras, Aerial Cameras (drones), camcorders, digital music players, tablets, smart watches, Cellular Phones

rules.title: Costco Canada adds a free second year of warranty on TVs, computers and big appliances
rules.window_note: 2 years from the day you bought it, if the maker's own warranty is shorter. It covers TVs, projectors, major appliances and computers bought from Costco Canada - not tablets. The maker's warranty terms decide what counts as a covered fault.
rules.what_you_get: The maker's warranty, stretched to 2 years at no cost. Costco's Technical and Warranty Service helps you with the claim, including in-home service when the maker's warranty includes it.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Costco Technical and Warranty Service. Have ready: your name, membership number, the Costco item number from your receipt, the item description, the model and serial number, and the purchase date.
rules.script_hint: I bought this at Costco and it broke within two years; Costco extends the maker's warranty to two years on this, so I'd like it repaired or replaced.
rules.source_quote: Costco extends the manufacturer’s warranty to two (2) years from the date of purchase for televisions, projectors, major appliances, and computers (excluding tablets) purchased from Costco Canada, if the manufacturer’s warranty is less than two years.

rules.title: Amazon.ca takes most things back within 30 days of delivery
rules.window_note: 30 days from delivery, for items in original or unused condition. Apple products bought new get only 15 days, and most baby products get 90. Final Sale items can't be returned, but if one arrives damaged or faulty, contact Customer Service. For a fault after the return window, Amazon says to contact the maker for warranty help.
rules.what_you_get: A refund, or a replacement or exchange. If a third-party seller shipped it themselves, it goes back to that seller, who must give you a Canadian return address, a prepaid label, or a refund without sending it back.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders, pick the item and choose Return Items. Most returns can be dropped off free at a nearby location, often with no box or label. Send it back before the return-by date in your confirmation email, and wipe any personal data from electronics first.
rules.script_hint: This arrived less than 30 days ago and it's faulty, so I'd like a refund or a replacement under the Amazon.ca return policy.
rules.source_quote: Most items can be returned for a refund or replacement/exchange within 30 days of delivery as long as they are in original or unused condition.

rules.title: Apple products bought new on Amazon.ca get only 15 days
rules.window_note: 15 days from delivery, for Apple-brand products sold in new condition. Most other things on Amazon.ca get 30 days. After 15 days, a fault is a job for Apple's own warranty.
rules.what_you_get: A refund, or a replacement or exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders, pick the item and choose Return Items. Wipe your personal data from the device first by following Apple's instructions, and send it back before the return-by date in your confirmation email.
rules.script_hint: This Apple product was delivered less than 15 days ago and it isn't working, so I'd like to return it under your 15-day policy for Apple products.
rules.source_quote: Most items sold on Amazon.ca can be returned within 30 days of delivery - some exceptions include: ... 15 days ... Apple Brand products sold in new condition

rules.title: Amazon.ca refunds you itself when a third-party seller won't
rules.window_note: You have 90 days after the latest estimated delivery date. Contact the seller first and give them 48 hours, and for a faulty item ask the seller for a return within 30 days of getting it. Items delivered with Prime or sold by Amazon Global Store don't qualify - contact Amazon instead - and neither does anything you already disputed with your bank or card. If it breaks more than 30 days after delivery, Amazon says to go to the maker's warranty.
rules.what_you_get: Amazon refunds you when the seller won't. For a damaged, faulty or not-as-described item, that covers the item price, the original shipping and the return shipping.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders, contact the seller and request a return. Wait 48 hours. If they haven't fixed it, go back to that order and request an A-to-z Guarantee refund. It usually takes one to two weeks to process.
rules.script_hint: The seller hasn't sorted out my faulty item more than 48 hours after I asked, so I'm filing an A-to-z Guarantee claim.
rules.source_quote: You have 90 days after the latest estimated delivery date to submit a claim.

rules.title: Home Depot Canada takes most things back within 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days from the day you bought it, with the receipt - or 365 days if you paid with a Home Depot credit card or commercial account. With a receipt after that, you may still get store credit for the original price. Power tools, TVs, computers, furniture and a few other things get only 30 days, and major appliances can't be returned at all. Things bought at Home Depot in the US can't be returned in Canada.
rules.what_you_get: A refund the same way you paid, or an exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Home Depot store in Canada with the receipt - store purchases can only go back in store. No receipt? They can look up card or cheque purchases from the last 90 days, and you'll need photo ID. For online orders, bring the order email to a store, start a return from your Order Details page, or call Customer Support within 90 days to book a pickup.
rules.script_hint: I bought this here less than 90 days ago and I have the receipt, so I'd like a refund or an exchange.
rules.source_quote: Returns with a valid sales receipt within 90 days of purchase will be exchanged or refunded in the same tender as the original purchase.

rules.title: Home Depot Canada gives power tools, TVs and computers only 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days for battery and corded tools and equipment (snowblowers too), and 30 days with a receipt for gas-powered equipment, generators, air conditioners, TVs, computers, printers, furniture and holiday decor. Report any damage or defect within 30 days. After 30 days, or without a receipt, the store may send it out for repair as your item instead of refunding it. Used mowers, lawn tractors, snow throwers and other gas-powered gear (not generators) are repaired, if possible, under the maker's warranty through an authorised service contractor.
rules.what_you_get: A refund or an exchange inside 30 days. After that, a possible repair - through the maker's warranty for used gas-powered equipment.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Home Depot store in Canada with the receipt. Anything that has had fuel in it can't be mailed back, so bring it to a store or call Customer Support for instructions. For used gas-powered equipment, call Customer Support to get it to an authorised repair shop.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] less than 30 days ago and it's defective; your policy lets me return it within 30 days, so I'd like a refund or an exchange.
rules.source_quote: Battery and corded equipment, (including snowblowers) must be returned within 30 days of delivery or in-store purchase. Any product damage and/or defects must be reported within 30 days.

rules.title: Home Depot Canada won't take back big appliances, so report damage within 48 hours
rules.window_note: Major appliances can't be returned. Check it when it's delivered and refuse it before you sign if you're not happy. Report any damage or defect to the delivery agent, and report damage within 48 hours of delivery. After 48 hours you can still go to your store or call 1-800-759-2054 for help, but the policy doesn't promise what they'll do.
rules.what_you_get: No refund - big appliances are final. You can refuse a damaged one before you sign for it, and you must report damage within 48 hours of delivery; the policy doesn't say whether you then get a repair or a replacement.
rules.how_to_claim: Look the appliance over before signing the delivery receipt and refuse it if it's damaged. Tell the delivery agent about any damage or defect. Then call within 48 hours of delivery, or visit your local Home Depot store.
rules.script_hint: My appliance was delivered less than 48 hours ago and it's damaged, and I'm reporting it within the 48 hours your policy asks for.
rules.source_quote: Major appliances are non-returnable. ... Damages must be reported within 48 hours of delivery. After 48 hours, you may visit your local store or call 1-800-759-2054 for assistance.

rules.title: Instant Pot fixes or replaces a faulty appliance for 1 year
rules.window_note: One year from the day you bought it, or the day it was delivered if that is later. It covers the original owner only, it must come from a store Instant Pot approves of, and it only counts for appliances bought and used in the US or Canada. You need proof of the purchase date, but you do not need to have registered it.
rules.what_you_get: Instant Pot picks: they repair the fault or replace the appliance. A replacement gets its own new 12 months of cover.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Instant Pot Customer Care or email support@instantpot.com, or open a ticket at instantpot.com/pages/contact-us. Have your receipt, the model number (on the back) and serial number (on the bottom) ready. If they ask you to send it in for inspection, include your name, address, phone, email, proof of the purchase date and what is wrong - Instant Pot does not pay that shipping.
rules.script_hint: My Instant Pot [item] stopped working less than a year after I bought it, and I have my receipt, so I'd like it repaired or replaced under your One Year Limited Warranty.
rules.source_quote: This One (1) Year Limited Warranty applies to purchases made one year from the purchase date or delivery date, whichever is later, from authorized retailers of Instant Pot Brands by the original appliance owner

rules.title: De'Longhi fully automatic espresso machines get 2 years of free parts and labour
rules.window_note: Two years from the day you bought it, for De'Longhi (and Kenwood) bean-to-cup (fully automatic) coffee machines bought and used in the US or Canada. De'Longhi's site says registering the machine before the warranty runs out adds one more year on many models (some exclusions apply), and anything bought on delonghi.com is already registered. It only covers machines bought from De'Longhi or a seller they approve of, not auctions, eBay or private sellers.
rules.what_you_get: Free parts and labour on the whole machine. De'Longhi repairs it with new or remanufactured parts, or replaces it with a new or certified remanufactured machine.
rules.how_to_claim: Call De'Longhi first and keep your receipt handy. You pay to ship the machine to an authorized De'Longhi service center (use a tracked, insured service, because they won't cover it if it's lost on the way), and De'Longhi pays to send it back.
rules.script_hint: My De'Longhi automatic espresso machine has developed a fault and it's less than two years old, so please tell me where to send it for a free repair under your two-year parts and labour warranty.
rules.source_quote: From the purchase date, our obligation under this warranty is to provide two (2) years free parts and labor on the entire unit.

rules.title: Other De'Longhi appliances get 1 year of free parts and labour
rules.window_note: One year from the day you bought it, for De'Longhi appliances bought and used in the US or Canada. De'Longhi uses this warranty for manual espresso machines, moka pots, drip coffee makers, cooking appliances, heaters, portable air conditioners and dehumidifiers, but its FAQ says portable heaters get 3 years, dehumidifiers 2 years and portable air conditioners 1 to 3 years depending on the model, so check the card in the box. Registering a coffee machine before the warranty runs out can add one more year, and Nespresso and Lattissima machines have their own warranty. It must be bought from De'Longhi or a seller they approve of, not eBay or a private seller.
rules.what_you_get: Free parts and labour. De'Longhi repairs it with new or remanufactured parts, or replaces it with a new or certified remanufactured one.
rules.how_to_claim: Call De'Longhi first with your receipt. You pay to ship it to an authorized De'Longhi service center (tracked and insured is best), and De'Longhi pays to send it back.
rules.script_hint: My De'Longhi [item] stopped working within a year of buying it, so I'd like a free repair or replacement under your one-year parts and labour warranty.
rules.source_quote: From the purchase date, our obligation under this warranty is to provide one (1) year free parts and labor on the entire unit.

rules.title: Nespresso repairs or replaces a faulty machine for 1 year
rules.window_note: One year from the day you bought it, or the day it was delivered if that is later, and you need the original proof of purchase. Nespresso USA says some machines bought directly from Nespresso get up to two years, so check your manual. Problems caused by scale build-up or skipped descaling are not covered, and neither is normal wear.
rules.what_you_get: Nespresso repairs or replaces the machine at no charge. The repaired or replacement machine is covered for whatever is left of the first year, or six months, whichever is longer.
rules.how_to_claim: Contact Nespresso for repair instructions and have your receipt or order confirmation ready.
rules.script_hint: My Nespresso machine has a fault and it's less than a year old, so I'd like it repaired or replaced under the Nespresso limited warranty.
rules.source_quote: Nespresso warrants this product against defects in materials and workmanship for a period of 1 year. The warranty period begins on the date of purchase or date of delivery (if later than the date of purchase)

rules.title: Nespresso machines have a 2-year guarantee in the UK
rules.window_note: Two years from the day you bought it, and you need the original proof of purchase. Problems caused by scale build-up, skipped descaling, normal wear or commercial use are not covered. This is on top of your UK consumer rights, not instead of them.
rules.what_you_get: Nespresso repairs or replaces the machine at no charge. The repaired or replacement machine is covered for whatever is left of the two years, or six months, whichever is longer.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Nespresso free on 0800 442 442 or use live chat on the Nespresso UK customer care page, and have your receipt or order confirmation ready.
rules.script_hint: My Nespresso machine has a fault and it's less than two years old, so I'd like it repaired or replaced under the Nespresso two-year guarantee.
rules.source_quote: Nespresso guarantees this product against defects in materials and workmanship for a period of 2 years. The guarantee period begins on the date of purchase

rules.title: Keurig repairs or replaces a faulty brewer for 1 year
rules.window_note: One year from the day you bought it, for normal home use, and you need proof of the purchase date. If Keurig decides the fault was caused by non-Keurig pods or accessories, they may refuse or charge a service fee.
rules.what_you_get: Keurig repairs or replaces the brewer free. A replacement may be new or reconditioned, and it gets a fresh one-year warranty.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Keurig Customer Service before sending anything back. They give you a Return Materials Authorization (RMA) number; a brewer sent back without one is returned to you unrepaired.
rules.script_hint: My Keurig brewer stopped working less than a year after I bought it and I have my receipt, so I'd like an RMA number to have it repaired or replaced under the limited one-year warranty.
rules.source_quote: Keurig Green Mountain, Inc. (Keurig) warrants that your brewer will be free of defects in materials or workmanship under normal home use for one year from the date of purchase.

rules.title: Keurig Canada repairs or replaces a faulty coffee maker for 1 year
rules.window_note: One year from the day you bought it, for normal home use, and you need proof of the purchase date. If Keurig decides the fault was caused by non-Keurig pods or accessories, they may refuse or charge a service fee.
rules.what_you_get: Keurig repairs or replaces the coffee maker free. A replacement may be new or reconditioned, and it gets a fresh one-year warranty.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Keurig Canada Customer Service before sending anything back. They give you a Return Materials Authorization (RMA) number; a coffee maker sent back without one is returned to you unrepaired.
rules.script_hint: My Keurig coffee maker stopped working less than a year after I bought it and I have my receipt, so I'd like an RMA number to have it repaired or replaced under the limited one-year warranty.
rules.source_quote: Keurig Green Mountain, Inc. (Keurig) warrants that your coffee maker will be free of defects in materials or workmanship under normal home use for one year from the date of purchase.

rules.title: SodaStream machines: at least 2 years, up to 4 if you register
rules.window_note: At least 2 years from the order date. Bought on sodastream.com: 3 years; bought in a store or on another site: register the machine and you get 2 more years, 4 in total. SodaStream's help page was updated in February 2026, but its formal warranty page still says registering adds only 1 year, so register and ask. Carbonating bottles are not covered, and neither is damage from other brands' gas cylinders or bottles or from fizzing anything but water.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement machine of new or comparable value, and SodaStream pays the shipping to send the broken one back. No refunds.
rules.how_to_claim: Don't take it back to the store. Find the sticker behind the gas cylinder (manufacturing date, serial number, machine type), then call SodaStream or use their contact form with a photo of the sticker and your receipt. If they approve a replacement, they email you a free shipping label.
rules.script_hint: My SodaStream stopped working and it's inside the warranty; I have my receipt and the serial number from the sticker, so I'd like a replacement and a return label.
rules.source_quote: Sodastream Sparkling Water Makers have at least a 2-year limited warranty ... For purchases in retail or from other online vendors, we offer an extra 2-years warranty for machine registration (total of a 4-year limited warranty).

rules.title: SodaStream Canada: at least 2 years, 4 if you register a store-bought machine
rules.window_note: At least 2 years from the day you bought it. If you bought it in a store or from another website, register it on SodaStream's site and you get 2 more years, 4 in total. It only applies if you used the machine the way the manual says, and you need the receipt.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement machine of new or comparable value, and SodaStream pays the shipping to send the broken one back.
rules.how_to_claim: Don't take it back to the store. Find the sticker behind the gas cylinder (manufacturing date, serial number, machine type), then call SodaStream Canada or use their contact form with a photo of the sticker and your receipt. If they approve a replacement, they email you a free shipping label.
rules.script_hint: My SodaStream stopped working and it's inside the warranty; I have my receipt and the serial number from the sticker, so I'd like a replacement and a return label.
rules.source_quote: SodaStream Sparkling Water Makers have at least a 2-year limited warranty ... Register your Sparkling Water Maker on our website to get an extra 2-years limited warranty for machine registration (total of 4-years limited warranty).

rules.title: SodaStream machines have a 2-year warranty in the UK
rules.window_note: Two years from the day you bought it. If you bought it from another shop, your user manual may give different terms, so check it. It only applies if you used the machine the way the manual says.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement machine of new or comparable value, and SodaStream pays the shipping to send the broken one back.
rules.how_to_claim: Raise a ticket online, call SodaStream UK (9am-5pm, Monday to Friday) or message them on Facebook. Have your receipt and the details from the sticker behind the gas cylinder ready.
rules.script_hint: My SodaStream stopped working less than two years after I bought it, so I'd like a replacement under the two-year warranty.
rules.source_quote: All Sodastream Sparkling Water Makers have a 2-year limited warranty, valid from the purchase date ... Sodastream will cover the return shipping and send you a replacement of new or comparable value, free of charge.

rules.title: Bosch 18V cordless tools: 5 years, batteries 3
rules.window_note: Five years on 18V cordless tools, 18V benchtop tools and 18V chargers bought on or after 1 June 2023 (one year if bought before that), and three years on 18V batteries. It starts on the day you bought it (in California, the delivery day if that is later) and covers only the original buyer of a tool sold in the US or Canada. If you lost the receipt, Bosch uses the tool's production code to date it. Wear parts like brushes, chucks and cords are not covered, and neither is damage from non-Bosch parts or outside repairs.
rules.what_you_get: Bosch repairs or replaces the faulty parts free.

rules.script_hint: My Bosch [tool] is faulty and it's under two years old, so I'd like it collected and repaired under the Bosch guarantee.
rules.source_quote: Bosch gives you a two-year guarantee on privately used tools. ... you can get three years guarantee on your newly purchased Bosch DIY power tool, garden tool or measuring tool

rules.title: Ninja kitchen appliances: usually 1 year, some models longer
rules.window_note: Many Ninja air fryers, blenders and Creami ice cream makers sold in the US have a one-year limited warranty from the day you bought them (for example the AF141 air fryer, BN701 blender and NC501 Creami); some SharkNinja products get 2, 3 or more years, and the length is on the product page on sharkninja.com and in your owner's guide. It covers the original owner only, for units bought from an authorized seller and used at home in North America (in California it starts on the delivery or pick-up day). Worn parts like blades, removable pots and racks are not covered.
rules.what_you_get: SharkNinja repairs or replaces the faulty unit or parts. A replacement is covered for 6 months or the rest of the original warranty, whichever is later, and a shipping and handling fee may apply for sending you the replacement.
rules.how_to_claim: Start a warranty claim through SharkNinja's Contact Us page. Have your receipt, model number and serial number ready.
rules.script_hint: My Ninja [item] stopped working less than a year after I bought it and I have my receipt, so I'd like to start a warranty claim for a repair or replacement.
rules.source_quote: SharkNinja warrants that the unit shall be free from defects in material and workmanship for a period of one (1) year from the date of purchase when it is used under normal household conditions

rules.title: Breville repairs, replaces or refunds a faulty appliance inside the warranty on its product page
rules.window_note: The length depends on the model and is listed on its product page on breville.com: for example 1 year on the Barista Express (BES870), 2 years on the Barista Pro (BES878) and the Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro (BOV900). It starts the day you bought it, or the day it was delivered if you live in California. You need the receipt, and it must be bought from Breville or a seller they approve of, not eBay or an auction.
rules.what_you_get: Breville picks: a repair with new or refurbished parts, a replacement with the same or a comparable model, or your money back. A repaired or replacement product is covered for the rest of the original warranty or 90 days, whichever is longer.
rules.how_to_claim: Don't take it back to the store. Find the model number and the 3- or 4-digit batch code (on a sticker underneath or on the back), have your receipt, and contact Breville Consumer Support. If it qualifies, Breville sends a prepaid shipping label; claims usually take up to 10 business days plus shipping.
rules.script_hint: My Breville [item] has a defect and it's still inside the warranty length on its product page, so I'd like a prepaid label to have it repaired or replaced.
rules.source_quote: will repair or replace it with the same model or comparable replacement free of charge ... To find the warranty length of your specific product, refer to the product page of the website for your country.

rules.title: Breville Canada repairs or replaces faulty appliances inside the warranty on the product page
rules.window_note: The length depends on the model and is listed on its product page on breville.com/en-ca; the Barista Express (BES870), for example, has 1 year. It starts the day you bought it. You need the receipt, and it must be bought from Breville or a seller they approve of.
rules.what_you_get: Breville picks: a repair with new or refurbished parts, a replacement with the same or a comparable model, or your money back.

rules.title: Samsonite suitcases: 10 years for factory faults on C-Lite, Proxis and Nexis, other models vary (UK)
rules.window_note: The length depends on the model and is on the warranty card inside the bag and on its product page; C-Lite, Proxis and Nexis suitcases carry the standard 10-year global warranty. It covers the first buyer or gift recipient with a receipt, order confirmation or stamped warranty card. Airline damage, wear and tear, and scratches or dents are not covered - but if you bought C-Lite (from 1 February 2026), Proxis or Nexis, register for Samsonite's WeCare program, which also repairs damage from travel.
rules.what_you_get: Samsonite repairs it, or replaces it if it can't be repaired, and pays to send it back to you. Often they post you a spare part so you can fix it at home. You pay to send it to the service centre.
rules.how_to_claim: Go back to the shop you bought it from or an official Samsonite store (another dealer may charge a fee), or start a request on Samsonite's Support&Go platform with the product ID (inside the bag or on the warranty card), your proof of purchase and photos.
rules.script_hint: My Samsonite suitcase has a manufacturing fault and it's still inside the warranty on the card, so I'd like it repaired or replaced under the Samsonite warranty.
rules.source_quote: you are not only covered by the standard 10-year global manufacturer’s warranty ... Samsonite will, at its discretion, either repair or replace the product in line with the warranty terms.

rules.title: Away repairs your suitcase free for 5 years, even airline damage
rules.window_note: For Away suitcases bought on or after 14 April 2026. For the first 5 years, repairs are free for damage that stops the suitcase working, whether from a factory fault or from travel such as airline mishandling, and shipping both ways is free. After year 5, repairs carry on for the life of the suitcase: still free in Away stores, otherwise a reasonable service fee may apply, and shipping stays free. Scuffs, scratches, dents, stains and lost or stolen bags are not covered, and bags and accessories have a separate one-year warranty.
rules.what_you_get: A free repair, with Away paying shipping both ways, or one replacement suitcase in the first 5 years if it can't be repaired. The paid LifetimeCare Pro add-on stretches this to 10 years and up to two replacements.
rules.how_to_claim: If an airline damaged it, file a claim with the airline first. Then start a claim in Away's Claims Center with your proof of purchase (registering the suitcase is not required), or ask an Away store about an in-store repair.
rules.script_hint: My Away suitcase was damaged and no longer works properly, and it's inside the first five years of LifetimeCare, so I'd like a free repair or replacement.
rules.source_quote: Free repairs for functional damage to your suitcase due to manufacturing defects or the unpredictability of travel (think airline mishandling). ... One luggage replacement within the first 5 years under our limited warranty if we’re unable to repair functional damage.

rules.title: Away suitcases bought before 14 April 2026 have a lifetime warranty on defects
rules.window_note: For polycarbonate, aluminum and nylon suitcases bought before 8:00 AM EST on 14 April 2026, for as long as the original buyer or gift recipient owns it. It covers shells that crack from faulty materials, wheels or handles that break off, zippers that won't open or close, and torn front pockets. Scratches, dents, scuffs and other cosmetic wear are not covered, and you need a copy of the receipt.
rules.what_you_get: Away repairs it, replaces it or offers other compensation - Away's choice - and pays shipping both ways for a covered defect. A replacement may be like-new or a different colour.
rules.how_to_claim: Submit a claim through Away's Claims Center with a copy of your receipt and photos of the fault.
rules.script_hint: My Away suitcase was bought before April 2026 and the [wheel] has broken from a defect, so I'd like it repaired or replaced under the limited lifetime warranty.

rules.window_note: One year from the day you bought it from Microsoft or an authorized store. Most Xbox accessories, such as a regular controller, get only 90 days; the Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2 and Xbox Wireless Headset get the full year, and refurbished Xbox consoles get 90 days. Drops, spills, cosmetic damage and repairs by others aren't covered. This is the warranty for things bought on or after 1 October 2024; older purchases have earlier versions on Microsoft's site.
rules.what_you_get: Microsoft picks one: a repair, a replacement (it may be refurbished), or your money back when you return it. The fixed or replaced item is covered for the rest of the year or 90 days, whichever is longer.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to support.microsoft.com/warranty, sign in, pick your device and follow the steps to start a service order. Back up and wipe it first, because Microsoft erases whatever is on it. Keep your receipt; they can ask for proof of purchase.
rules.script_hint: My [item] has a hardware fault and I bought it less than a year ago, so it's covered by Microsoft's one-year limited hardware warranty.
rules.source_quote: this Warranty lasts for one year from the date of original purchase from Microsoft or an authorized reseller, unless a different time appears below.

rules.title: Hisense TVs get 1 year of parts and labor
rules.window_note: One year from the day you bought it, for TVs sold in the US and Puerto Rico by an authorized Hisense dealer. TVs sold 'as is' or 'final sale' aren't covered, and remotes and stands get 90 days. Hisense's own site lists some newer TVs under a 2-year warranty, so check the card that came in your box.
rules.what_you_get: Hisense repairs the TV or gives you a like-new or refurbished one of similar or better quality. Some TVs get an in-home visit; others go to Hisense's warehouse, and every panel repair is done there.
rules.how_to_claim: Call the Hisense Care Center at 1-888-935-8880 or email service@hisense-usa.com, with your dated receipt ready. Keep the original box: damage from poor packing on the way to Hisense voids the warranty.
rules.script_hint: My Hisense TV is under a year old and has a fault, so please repair or replace it under the one-year limited warranty; I have my dated receipt.
rules.source_quote: All LCD/LED TV's: One (1) year for parts and labor (replacement Product and parts assume the remaining original warranty period, or ninety (90) days, whichever is longer).

rules.title: Hisense TVs in Canada get 1 year of parts and labour
rules.window_note: One year from the date you bought it. TVs 50 inches and under are carry-in only; 55 inches and up get in-home service. Not covered: physical damage, commercial use, TVs bought outside Canada, as-is or refurbished TVs, or a bill of sale in someone else's name.
rules.what_you_get: A free repair or replacement by Hisense's authorized service centre.
rules.how_to_claim: Start a service request on Hisense Canada's support site with your original bill of sale ready.
rules.script_hint: My Hisense TV is under a year old and has a fault, so it's covered by Hisense Canada's one-year parts and labour warranty.

rules.what_you_get: A free in-home repair by a Hisense authorized service centre.
rules.how_to_claim: Start a service request on Hisense Canada's support site with your original bill of sale ready.

rules.what_you_get: Nikon picks: a free repair, a replacement with similar specs and value, or a refund of the price on your receipt.
rules.how_to_claim: Send it to a Nikon service facility with the warranty form and receipt; you pay the postage and insurance to send it. Get the address at nikonusa.com/support or 1-800-645-6687 in the US, or nikon.ca/support or 1-877-534-9910 in Canada.
rules.script_hint: My Nikon [item] is under a year old and has a defect, so it's covered by Nikon's one-year limited warranty; here are my receipt and warranty form.
rules.source_quote: This Product is warranted by Nikon to be free from defects in material and workmanship for one (1) year from the date of purchase by the original consumer purchaser.
